vb_textbox.text: I found more often than not that the tall gnome with a brown pointy hat provided more mushrooms than the short gnome with a red hat. Conversely, I found that the small gnome with the green hat usually had more mushrooms than the tall gnome with the purple pointy hat. I also found that the mushroom counts didn't change much between rounds if I picked the exact same gnome consecutively. Finally, I felt like if one tall gnome with a pointy hat was providing a large amount of mushrooms, then the next time I saw the other gnome with a pointy hat, that other gnome more often than not would provide fewer mushrooms, and vice versa (i.e. one tall gnome provides low amount of mushrooms, then picking the other tall gnome the next time he's seen is more likely to provide a larger amount of mushrooms).
